notes.title: Bug Fixed – The Daguerreotype is Back in Action!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First of all, a huge thank you to everyone who has played the demo and shown interest in our project! Your support and feedback mean the world to us, and we’re incredibly grateful for the excitement around our game.

We've just released a small but important update for the demo. We noticed a bug that prevented the game from correctly creating and developing Serenity's daguerreotype, which was causing issues for some players.

What’s Fixed?

[list]
[*] The daguerreotype take now functions as intended.
[*] The reagent is correctly created and can be used properly.
[*] Minor fixes on the Serenity's autopsy and dossier.
[*] Minor fixes on in game SFX.
[*] Minor fixes on Main Menu save slots.
[*] Increased quality of the whole 3D analysis interactions.
[/list]

Your feedback helps us improve the game, and we truly appreciate it! Try out the updated demo and let us know if you encounter any other issues!

Bringing this project to life has been an incredible journey, and it’s an honor to share our little creation with you. We genuinely hope to meet your expectations and deliver an experience that you will enjoy and remember. Thank you for being part of this adventure with us!

[i]"…You have to discover the truth detective."[/i]

– Bob's Cult Studio
